evidence.excerpt: Progress in embodied foundation models is largely measured by task success, while the physical safety of their decisions remains underexamined.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Our protocol assesses mode correctness, risk identification, and actionable handling, with complete decision accuracy requiring all applicable checks to pass.
